subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Twin Turbo Configurations
description: A short lesson to help you apply Twin Turbo Configurations.

hook.text: One turbo is good, but some engineers bolted on two for even more power and flexibility.

buildup.text: Parallel twins each feed one bank of a V engine, splitting the work evenly between them.

discovery.text: Sequential twins use a small turbo for low speed and a large one for high-speed power.

twist.text: The legendary Toyota Supra 2JZ used sequential twins for smooth power across the whole range.

climax.text: Modern single turbos with variable geometry have made twin setups less necessary for most cars.

punchline.text: Two turbos solved lag before technology caught up.

quiz.question: How do sequential twin turbos work?
options: A small one at low speed, a large one at high speed
